A Hotel we always enjoy returning to
May 2026 • Family
I have stayed at Lotte Hotel Saigon several times over the past few years, and it continues to be one of my favorite hotels in Ho Chi Minh City.
The hotel is beautiful, comfortable, and ideally located for the places I usually visit. The breakfast is also excellent, with a delicious and satisfying selection.
What makes each stay especially memorable, however, is the warm hospitality of Elly at breakfast. Her kindness, thoughtfulness, and genuine smile always make us feel truly welcome. It would not be an exaggeration to say that Elly is one of the main reasons I continue to choose this hotel.
As we had a late-night flight, we were also very grateful to be able to use the shower facilities after checking out. This thoughtful service made our final hours in Ho Chi Minh City much more comfortable.
Thank you to Elly and the entire hotel team for another wonderful stay. We look forward to returning again.

A wide menu.
Jun 2026 • Business
Taste for Japanese people. There was also a lot on the menu.
Four choose from chicken and beef to order. Choose the condiments you have before.

Porridge, Japanese buckwheat noodles and scrolls were also available. It was easy to drink and deliciously cold, perhaps because the coconut juice was fresh. There are plenty of them, and if you drink too much, you won't be able to add food.

There was a wide variety of fruit, bread, mafia, cookies, doughnuts and more.
They were all delicious.

I couldn't eat it once and divided it into two days, but I couldn't clear all the products.

We had a veteran female staff member who was very attentive to us. EUg(Loan)r9arco(Cheg) on the business card you gave us? That's what it said.
The staff do not speak Japanese. I can understand English.

There was a Korean convenience store (smaller) nearby that was open 24 hours a day.
It seems that there may be no change for the big Vietnamese Dong, so you can rest assured if you pay around 20000 Vietnamese Dong (1200 yen).
It looked like Japanese oden and had toppogi, snacks, a little bento, household goods (a few portions) and drinks.

In front of the convenience store, neighbors (three to seven) sat on tables and chairs, eating and drinking, happily talking.
The atmosphere is not bad.
